meta.name: game-art-direction
meta.description: Direct game art and creative vision. Turn GAME_DESIGN into a production-level ART_DIRECTION defining a recognizable visual style, camera and composition, world and character grammar, functional colour/light/material, HUD feedback, motion and transition specs, audio direction, and a signature moment for every screen and mode. Use for what should the game look like, set the art direction, define the visual style. 游戏美术与创意方向。把 GAME_DESIGN 转成策划级 ART_DIRECTION，定义可辨识视觉风格、镜头构图、世界与角色语法、功能性色光材质、界面反馈、运动与转场规格、声音方向和每个界面/模式的签名游戏时刻。用于判断游戏应该长什么样、制定游戏美术方向等需求。
